research_question: Does controlled semantic augmentation improve Korean policy NLI across held-out surface forms and values without degrading general Korean NLI?
scope: Evidence-relative entailment, contradiction and insufficient information. Correction reason and change provenance are distinct tasks; neither is inferred from contradiction alone.

data.general: Official KLUE-NLI v1.1 train; 10% premise-group hash split for local validation. Official dev 3000 used as evaluation, not called official test.
data.leakage: Exclude official-train premise groups overlapping official-dev premises. Record source versions and all IDs. Test labels never passed to training.
data.policy: AI-authored formal contrast sets. Identical hypothesis occurs with each of the three labels within a contrast group. Disjoint surface templates, entities and value ranges across train/validation/evaluation. Same designer knows the grammar: not independently human-validated.
data.old_pilot: All initial 48 + stress 5 are known development/regression material, never new held-out evidence.
data.official_documents: Source-grounded case studies with provenance and explicit provisional labels; no claim of independent annotation or population representativeness. Never used for training.

base_training.selection: fixed last epoch, no score-based selection

paired_continuation.augmentation: same first 16 general examples plus 16 policy training examples per step
paired_continuation.initialization: same base checkpoint per seed; reset optimizer and RNG for both branches; fixed last step

evaluation.primary: Policy held-out accuracy difference between matched control and augmentation; all 3 seeds separately and mean/std
evaluation.bootstrap: 10000 paired resamples of contrast groups; benchmark resamples grouped by normalized premise; intervals conditional on designed dataset and observed seeds
evaluation.claim_gate: Report negative results. No policy generalization claim from synthetic improvement alone. No significance claim from overlapping triplets or selective best seed.

limits: Public benchmark contamination in pretraining cannot be ruled out
Synthetic grammar validity is not independent linguistic annotation
Three training seeds are a small replication sample
Actual policy correction extraction requires separate evidence annotation
No claim of new model architecture or established academic novelty
